usedFor: A “New Quote” in AutoQuote3D is answered in a Telegram chat with “Reply To Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Quote” in AutoQuote3D, then “Reply To Message” in Telegram
bestTemplate.why: It puts quote details into a Telegram conversation, which suits a shop that quotes in chat.

watchOut: Both AutoQuote3D triggers poll, so the Telegram reply lags a bit.
